sql:
SELECT 
    CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y', drivers.dob) < 1985 AND results.laps > 50 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(DISTINCT drivers.driverId) 
FROM 
    drivers 
JOIN 
    results ON drivers.driverId = results.driverId 
WHERE 
    results.raceId IN (
        SELECT raceId FROM races WHERE strftime('%Y', races.date) BETWEEN 2000 AND 2005
    )
